requirements: Register the page as the route `/contact` in `src/App.tsx`.
Each form field has a visible label (wrap the control in a `<label>`) and a `name` attribute: `name`, `email`, `message`.

acceptance.text: `/contact` renders the page with the `h1` “Contact us”.
The form has labelled fields `name` (text), `email` (type email) and `message` (textarea) and a submit button “Send message” built with `Button`.
Submitting the form shows “Thanks! We’ll get back to you soon.” without reloading the page (manual check).
The navigation shows “Contact” (to `/contact`) after “Pricing” on every page.

hints: Routes are declared in `src/App.tsx` with `<Routes>`/`<Route>` from `react-router` (v7, declarative mode).
Tailwind CSS v4: theme tokens live in `src/index.css` under `@theme`; use their utilities (e.g. `bg-primary-600`). There is no tailwind.config.js.
